summary: YPF S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting a 10-for-1 stock split and par value reduction from ARS 10 to ARS 1 per share, effective August 4, 2026, for holders of record as of August 3, 2026. The company states the split does not alter economic value or ownership percentages, and will adjust the ADS ratio from 1:1 to 10:1. The stated reasons are to improve market liquidity on ByMA and increase accessibility for retail investors. No consideration, premium, or closing conditions beyond the effective date are mentioned. This is a non-event for special-situation purposes, merely a capital structure adjustment.
